comment: Running the H2 initialization script unconditionally on every bean initialization is not idempotent. The portal script inserts fixed seed rows into tables like `ServerConfig`, `Users`, and `Authorities`, so re-creating the application context or restarting against a persisted H2 database can re-run the script and fail with duplicate-key/constraint violations. Please make the bootstrap idempotent (for example by using `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` / `MERGE`/`INSERT ... WHERE NOT EXISTS`, or by guarding execution so it only runs once per database lifecycle).
